title: Sparkline: Rerank evaluation pipeline, NDCG/MRR telemetry, and A/B hooks
creator: Marcus Lee
description:
Summary:
We need a production-ready evaluation and telemetry pipeline for reranking that tracks NDCG@k and MRR, supports customer prompt sets for offline evals, and exposes A/B testing hooks so product teams can measure quality changes without manual log wrangling. This ticket wires the metrics into Console, adds request/response experiment metadata to the rerank API, and implements a scalable runner for batched offline NDCG calculations.

Goals and acceptance criteria:
- Emit per-request rerank telemetry: rerank_time_ms, rerank_scores_raw, rerank_topk_indices, rerank_experiment_id, rerank_variant. Events should be ingestible by existing metrics pipeline and visible in Console dashboards.
- Track and surface NDCG@1/3/5/10 and MRR@10 in daily/rolling windows per model+index. Dashboards and automated alerts when regression > 2% absolute and statistically significant (p < 0.05).
- Customer prompt sets: secure upload flow to S3/GDrive (via PM-run intake) that the evaluation runner can consume. Must support mixed-format queries (natural language, templated prompts) and human-assigned relevance judgments.
- A/B hooks: allow API customers and internal experiments to pass experiment metadata (X-Rerank-Exp-ID, X-Rerank-Variant) and have the system produce experiment-scoped metrics and sample export for statistical analysis.
- Performance budget: additional median latency for rerank scoring step should not exceed 12 ms for Top-10 re-score on typical vector sizes (dim=1536) at steady-state production throughput.

Work completed so far:
- Prototype eval runner implemented in tools/rerank-eval-runner (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rerank-evals/pull/1234). Runner supports reading CSV prompt sets, computing cosine similarities for embeddings, and computing NDCG/MRR. Initial runs on small datasets (1k queries) completed; baseline pipeline validated against offline notebook.
- Telemetry schema drafted and reviewed with Observability: https://confluence.redwood.ai/embeddings/rerank-telemetry-schema. Event field names and tags agreed on in meeting (Sofia Gomez, Jun Park, Aisha Patel).
- API change proposal created for adding experiment headers/metadata to POST /v1/rerank: https://docs.redwood.ai/api/rerank-proposal. Backwards compatible by default (fields optional).
- Console dashboard mockups uploaded: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RerankDashboardsMockups. Early feedback from PM shows need for cohort filtering and per-customer prompt-set linking.

Open trade-offs and risks:
- Accuracy vs latency: High-fidelity reranking (neural cross-encoders) yields better NDCG but increases latency by 30-150ms. We will implement a two-stage approach: fast vector retrieval + lightweight learned shallow re-ranker (CPU/GPU-optimized) as default; allow customers to opt into slower cross-encoder variants via model tier.
- Data residency: customer prompt sets may contain PII. Intake flow must be an enterprise-only feature with KMS-protected buckets and restricted access. PM scope to enforce policy.
- Stat significance at low traffic: for customers with low query volume, A/B windows will be too small for robust p-values. We'll provide guidance in Console and offer aggregated cohort-level evaluation.

Implementation plan (high-level):
1) Telemetry event & metrics plumbing (owner: Observability / Aisha) - 2 sprints
   - Implement event emission in rerank worker (names above).
   - Add ingestion mapping and tags into metrics pipeline (Datadog + BigQuery export).
   - Add example queries/ saved views for NDCG/MRR.
2) Eval runner & prompt-set ingestion (owner: Marcus) - 3 sprints
   - Harden runner for large-scale batch runs (parallelization via Ray / k8s jobs).
   - Support mixed relevance labels and multiple gold standards per prompt.
   - Add output serializer for Console and CSV export for stats team.
3) API + A/B metadata (owner: API infra / Jun) - 1 sprint
   - Add optional headers/metadata to POST /v1/rerank: X-Rerank-Exp-ID, X-Rerank-Variant, experiment_salt.
   - Ensure metadata is logged on request contexts and tied to metrics.
4) Console UI + Alerts (owner: Console / PM) - 2 sprints
   - Dashboard panels: NDCG@k timeseries, MRR distribution, per-experiment cohort comparison table (with p-value).
   - Automated regression alerting rule and per-customer opt-in for prompt-set linking.

Operational considerations:
- Sampling: to keep costs bounded, sample 1:10 of rerank requests for full score histogram capture by default; allow customers to increase sampling via route config.
- Storage: keep scored examples and prompt-set linkage for 90 days unless customer requests longer retention.
- Scaling: large offline evals will run on a dedicated k8s job pool; runner will distribute embeddings lookup requests and compute NDCG in parallel.

Notes from recent reviews:
- "We should include top-k index signature to make results deterministic for NDCG calculations" — Sofia Gomez (03/05). Ticket updated to include rerank_topk_indices telemetry.
- "Add a variant-level p95 latency column to the A/B table so teams can see cost/latency tradeoffs alongside quality" — Jun Park (03/07). Added to dashboard mockups.

Next steps (short-term):
- Deliver telemetry emission + ingestion mapping (deadline 2026-03-15).
- Harden runner to support parallel NDCG runs up to 100k queries (deadline 2026-03-29).
- API change landed + integration test that experiment headers are persisted to metrics (deadline 2026-03-22).

Acceptance criteria (explicit):
- Console shows NDCG@1/3/5/10 and MRR@10 for each model+index with 24h and 7d windows.
- Experiment-scoped metrics visible and downloadable for A/B analysis (including p-values and sample sizes).
- Default rerank latency overhead <= 12ms median for Top-10 on production vector dims at expected QPS; verified with load tests (link to job results after run).

Follow-ups / future work (out of scope for this ticket):
- Cross-encoder fallback as an explict paid tier (follow-up epic).
- UI flows for customers to label relevance manually from Console (post-release).
